allow_empty.reason: The scene holds no renderable geometry: its only Shape is a placeholder (a Switch with whichChoice -1 around an IndexedTriangleSet with an empty Coordinate; a script fills the frames at run time). The import yields one hidden mesh with 0 polygons, so an empty glb is correct (Confirmed 13 Nov 2026, Blender 5.3.0 bpy).

Harness limit, not an add-on defect. X_ITE draws this scene differently on every run (the audit measured noise 74.5 against a delta of 44.4; this gate measured 29.05 on one run), so no round-trip delta is a usable threshold. Separately, Babylon.js drew none of the 75,314 glb triangles from the 28.8 MB glb within the rig timeout (geometry share 0.0); cause not investigated and not necessarily the add-on (this gate, Confirmed 13 Nov 2026).
